overview.oneLineTake: A perfect storm of trade war escalation, failed Treasury intervention, and AI jitters ahead of Nvidia earnings points to continued risk-off pressure with the debasement trade (BTC/gold) as the primary beneficiary.
themes: Escalating US-Canada trade war — Talks collapsed, 50% auto/steel tariffs effective Jan 1, Canada vows dollar-for-dollar retaliation starting Sept 8; CAD tumbling, Canadian stocks whipsawing, and Ford's $3B Canadian bet caught in crosshairs.

Iran economic warfare intensifies — Bessent announces "economic D-Day" sanctions; Hormuz shipping costs hit $20M per supertanker; US scraps Korea marine drills; oil prices falling on supply expectations but risk premium remains elevated.

Treasury intervention failing — Bessent's bond buyback program dismissed as "financial repression" by Citadel Securities; Goldman/Wells say buybacks won't cut long rates; 30-year yield resumed climb despite intervention; prediction markets doubt effectiveness.

Tech/AI selloff ahead of Nvidia earnings — Chip rout dragging indices lower; Broadcom credit risk soaring on mega AI debt financing; SEC investigating near-implosion of AI hedge fund; Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole looming as pivotal tests.
Debasement trade surging — Bitcoin up on biggest 3-day rally since 2023, approaching $80K; Bessent's bond maneuvers fueling crypto/gold narrative; Wall Street refocusing on debasement trade.
risks: Trade war escalation — Trump threatening even higher tariffs; Canada "at war" rhetoric; potential QE return if trade war damages economy.
Bond market dysfunction — Treasury intervention failing could trigger further yield spike; Fed owns >50% of 10-15yr maturities; basis trade distortions.
AI credit stress — Broadcom's mega AI debt backstops and Guggenheim loan at 73-cent low signal cracks in leveraged AI financing.
Geopolitical tail risk — Iran bounties on Trump family, cyberattacks on UK power grid, and potential Hormuz disruption.
